nodes.title: Start here · Blocks & Beats · a decision arcade
widgets_values:
DEMO: A self-playing simplified Tetris game conducts an authored soundtrack. Open ꘅ Decision Arcade with ▦. In its page, the board rules shortlist four legal drops, d1 chooses one, and a separate d1 decision chooses calm/drive/tense/celebrate music. The game applies only validated labels. The renderer and audio scheduler run independently of the bounded local inference worker.
1. Read Tutorial 8 in the demo page. Choose d1 or an explicit no-AI heuristic comparison.
2. Start game. Watch candidate metrics, the chosen drop, distributions and timing.
3. Start audio separately. A pending music pattern changes at the next bar.
4. Pause/Reset cancels pending decisions and rejects old results; errors pause rather than falling back. No camera, microphone, cloud or generated code. Comfy Run does not start game/audio.
